notes: Feels like a phone app: fixed top bar, smooth screen changes, press feedback, no zoom or pull-to-refresh.
Forms slide up from the bottom; swipe down or use the phone's back button to close them.
The status bar matches the app colours, and returning to a list keeps your place.
Long-press the app icon for shortcuts to Add transaction and Lending.
An Install button appears when the app is opened in the phone browser.
New "Erase all data" button in Settings to clear sample or test data and start fresh.
EMI entries can include an amount paid upfront.
Record one lump sum and it is split across the oldest unpaid EMIs.
Tap a person to see charts of everything they owe and have paid.
The app now tells you when a new version is ready.
First version: transactions, budgets, reports, savings goals, bills, and lending and EMI tracking.
